title: Symbolic regression fitted a finite-Reynolds-number correction for turbulent velocity profiles
summary: A data-fitted expression adjusted the outer wake contribution in zero-pressure-gradient turbulent boundary layers as Reynolds number varied. The mean-velocity relation was compared with 35 simulation and experiment profiles across friction Reynolds numbers from 252 to 72,526. Its high-Reynolds-number limit was imposed during modeling.
organization: Chinese Academy of Sciences; Northwestern Polytechnical University

source_review.scope: v1 reference datasets, symbolic-regression implementation and Sections 4.1–4.2

evidence.tested: The authors identified the fitted correction from specified direct- and large-eddy-simulation profiles and compared the relation with other profiles including experimental datasets.
evidence.unknown: Out-of-fit profiles were not an independent statistical validation set. The limiting value is a design constraint, and reported data sources differ in the outer layer.
evidence.ai_role: PySR fit near-wall and finite-Reynolds-number corrections under prescribed physical asymptotes.
